cv.summary: Software Engineer with {commercialExperience}+ years of commercial experience in front-end development and over {professionalExperience} years of overall professional experience. Specialized in designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise web applications using React, Next.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript. Experienced in building scalable and maintainable user interfaces, establishing application architecture, improving code quality, implementing state management solutions, developing automated tests, and conducting code reviews. Participated in all phases of the software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and solution implementation to testing, deployment support, and ongoing maintenance. Proven ability to collaborate effectively within Agile/Scrum teams and work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver business value. Strong team player with mentoring experience, a proactive mindset, and a passion for continuous learning and modern software engineering practices
